Subject: Plan: architect-focused demo invite — Jun/Jul wave

Team —

Drafting the invite for a private architect deep-dive we can offer ACME (they asked for a smaller, engineering-focused session). High-level plan below; please flag changes by EOD today so we can seed the RSVP and HQ copy tomorrow.

Audience segments (priority):
- ACME platform architects + infra leads (seed from field list)
- 12–20 target accounts (priority: ACME, RidgeWave, DataForge)

Proposed schedule:
- Initial invite: Jun 22 (email + LinkedIn DM pass-through)
- Reminder 1: 4 days after invite
- Reminder 2: 1 day before session + calendar nudge

Tracking and copy notes:
- Use dedicated RSVP link with params: utm_campaign=acme_demo&utm_source=email&utm_medium=invite
- A/B subject test: technical vs. business-focused (see attached matrix)

Ask: review audience + subject suggestions, and confirm we can include the short case study slide on cost/unit savings (requested by ACME).

Attachment: invite-copy-v1.docx (contains draft email + CTA buttons and RSVP link placeholders)

Thanks,
Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>, acme-marketing@acmecorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: Architect deep-dive — private session for ACME

Hi Sara / ACME team —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. We pulled together a short private deep-dive session for your platform engineers focused on inference economics, latency optimizations, and deployment patterns across hosted/dedicated/private modes.

Proposed session (60 min):
- 20 min: small-architecture talk (Redwood engineering)
- 20 min: live demo & Q&A (deployments + profiling)
- 15 min: brief case study (customer cost/latency outcome)
- 5 min: next steps

We can run a public webinar, but given your ask for a smaller engineering session, we can make this invite-only for ACME. RSVP here: https://redwood.com/rsvp?utm_campaign=acme_demo (seats limited).

Attached: agenda-acme.pdf (one-pager)

Question for you: which of these dates works best for your team?
- Wed Jul 7, 10–11am PT
- Thu Jul 15, 1–2pm PT
- Tue Jul 20, 9–10am PT

If those don't work, tell us a week window and we'll align. Also — you mentioned needing a short compliance note for audit teams; we can include a 1-slide compliance appendix.

Best,
Ben
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: agenda-acme.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-marketing@acmecorp.com, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:43:21 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood: Architect deep-dive — private session for ACME

Ben —

Thanks for sending. The agenda looks great — a couple of asks from our side before we lock a slot:

1) Dates: Jul 15 looks best for most of our infra team (1–2pm PT). Can we tentatively hold that?
2) Content: please include a short customer example that shows cost/unit before/after (numbers are helpful). Who is the customer in the case study?
3) Compliance: yes — send the one-slide appendix for our audit team. Also include any SOC2 / data residency notes we can share with procurement.

If you can send updated copy and the calendar invite by EOD Friday, we can promote internally.

Sara Thompson
Head of Platform Engineering | ACME Corp
sara.thompson@acmecorp.com
